_meta.purpose: Draft for app/ingest/coinSources.json (Phase 3 step 4A). Keys are Binance perp bases (1000/1000000 prefix stripped). Loader must ignore keys starting with '_'.

fields.name: display name; overrides tickers.nameOf(base) (needed for ONE: CoinGecko says 'ONEchain', Binance ONEUSDT is Harmony).
fields.aliases: whole phrases that PROVE the headline is about this coin. Matched case-INsensitively, word-bounded: (^|[^a-z0-9])phrase([^a-z0-9]|$). Never a bare common word.
fields.weak: bare words that count only CASE-SENSITIVELY (as written) AND only when the title also contains a crypto-context word (CONTEXT_RE in the review) AND the title has no stock words. Absent => ambiguous ? [] : [BASE, name].
fields.ambiguous: true => bare BASE never counts by itself in any case; only aliases, $BASE, BASEUSDT, '(BASE)' parenthetical, or weak+context count.
fields.query: Google News query WITHOUT when:. Only quoted phrases OR'd, plus '<Name> crypto' unquoted where the name is distinctive. Never a bare common word unquoted: Google pads no-hit queries with unrelated crypto news (seen live: '"Harmony Protocol" crypto' returned 4 generic items).

junk_seen_live.low_value_flood: tokenpost.com / pluang.com / tradersunion.com emit 5-15 'X jumps 3.2% in one hour' items per coin per day; keep them but score importance 10 (PRICE_MOVE_RE in review).

rebrands_and_traps.FET: Fetch.ai merged into the Artificial Superintelligence Alliance (ASI); token is still FET. SingularityNET (ex-AGIX) news is FET-relevant; Ocean Protocol left the alliance in 2025 -> not an alias.
rebrands_and_traps.WLD: Worldcoin rebranded to 'World' / 'World Network' (Oct 2024); 'World' alone is unusable, use 'World Network', 'World ID', 'World App', 'Tools for Humanity'.
rebrands_and_traps.ENA: USDe / sUSDe are Ethena's products -> ENA-relevant, included.
rebrands_and_traps.ONE: Binance ONEUSDT = Harmony. nameOf('ONE') returns 'ONEchain' (CoinGecko collision) -> name overridden here.
rebrands_and_traps.XAI: Xai Games (Arbitrum L3). Elon's xAI collides case-insensitively -> never use bare 'xai'.
rebrands_and_traps.ARK: ARK (ark.io) is NOT 'Ark Protocol' (Bitcoin L2 by Ark Labs) and not ARK Invest.
rebrands_and_traps.MATIC/POL: not in the set; when added use name 'Polygon', aliases ['Polygon', 'Polygon Labs', 'POL token', 'MATIC'] and NOT 'Polygon veterans'-style ecosystem mentions (tagger issue, Step 2).
rebrands_and_traps.MUBARAK: present in base_break_live.json setups today (not in the caller's list) -> record added.
